title: The small processes' choices recorded where they are made: the reader chosen, every cleaning step kept, a synthetic table's design and an evidence search's first record
request: Phase 7 (the owner): a student behind every choice; the rest of 29.6: points for the structure reader, each cleaning step accepted or not, the synthetic schema's shape and the retrieval's records, each recorded where it is made with its truth source named.
plan: Map where each of the four choices is made and what reaches self-play.
Declare four points with states of codes, flags, counts and measures only, and their truth sources.
Record each where it is decided, inside a capture that never fails the product path, and test each record read back.

decisions.decision: The structure point is the reader chosen, not a header or a type.
decisions.why: The reader never detects a header (the first row always is one) and types are decided later by cleaning and the profile: the reader's choice is the decision the structure reader makes.

decisions.decision: A cleaning point per step and column it changed, beside the first-step point.
decisions.why: The first-step point keeps one step per column; later steps on a column and the table-level steps had no record.

decisions.decision: A synthetic design's state holds only what was known before it.
decisions.why: Whether the rules fell back, or how many attempts the model took, is the decision's own outcome: a student would read the answer from it.

decisions.decision: Each evidence search is its own subject, never the question's hash.
decisions.why: A hash of a short question can be reversed by a dictionary, and the ledger never holds a person's words.

decisions.decision: The Done when is reported as not met for self-play.
decisions.why: Self-play reads replicas through studio.data.attach_data and reaches none of the four places.

change: dclab_core.ledger: STRUCTURE_FORMATS, points data.structure_format, data.cleaning_keep, data.synthetic_shape and evidence.records, thirteen state fields; adapters.conformance: the four unmapped with their reason; capture.structure_read, synthetic_shape, evidence_search and cleaning's per-step records; structure.evidence and info['reader']; clean's names step logs the renamed pairs; retrieval.search names bm25 on its keyword path; CAPTURED texts with their truth sources; the data catalog.

findings.scenario: A JSON array file: the reader reported json_records, not one of the readers.
findings.cause: The reader refines info['format'] after it reads.
findings.fix: info['reader'] keeps the reader chosen; the point records it.

findings.defect: A model's synthetic design was refused by the ledger.
findings.cause: A model's answer is used only from level 2.
findings.fix: Recorded at level 2: the design acts after the spec's check.

findings.defect: The synthetic state held its own verdict.
findings.scenario: fell_back true always meant the rules' template; attempts without it always meant the model.
findings.cause: Outcomes of the design written as its evidence.
findings.fix: The state keeps the rows asked and whether a model serves; the model's empty answer and why are an answer.

findings.defect: An uploader's file name could reach a state.
findings.cause: Any short alphanumeric suffix was kept.
findings.fix: A closed list of the suffixes the reader knows; anything else is other.

findings.defect: A renamed column's records carried another column's bands, and a wrong first step.
findings.scenario: 'Total  Amount' (text with n/a) and 'Total Amount' (integers): after the names step the text column's steps were recorded with the integers' bands.
findings.cause: The log names columns by their new names, the raw profile by the old.
findings.fix: The names step logs the renamed pairs and the records map new names back to raw ones.

findings.defect: Every search was recorded with an unknown method.
findings.scenario: The keyword path returned hits with no method.
findings.cause: retrieval.search returned the index's hits as they were.
findings.fix: Every hit on the keyword path names bm25.

findings.defect: The structure evidence could fail an upload already read.
findings.scenario: An error in evidence() raised outside the quiet capture.
findings.cause: It was computed as an argument at the call site.
findings.fix: The capture takes the path and computes it inside.

findings.scenario: The value was always the first option, in rank order.
findings.cause: The options kept the search's order.

findings.defect: The texts claimed more than was built.
findings.scenario: The status said the rest built without saying self-play reaches none; truth sources were in a comment, not in CAPTURED; the cleaning point holds one answer.
findings.fix: The status says the Done when is not met for self-play, what is not recorded and why; each CAPTURED text names its truth.

findings.defect: The evidence did not cover every check the reader makes.
findings.scenario: A text file opening with a brace: JSON lines and one JSON document had the same state.
findings.cause: evidence() omitted the JSON lines check.
findings.fix: json_lines added; the whole-file JSON check (it reads the whole file) said not to be there.

findings.defect: The synthetic route, an unknown reader and cleaning without a profile were untested.
findings.scenario: Only the capture functions were called directly.
findings.cause: Tests written for the captures alone.
findings.fix: The synthetic route's two records, an unknown reader refused and the table-size-only states.

outcome: Four more choices are decisions in the ledger, recorded from real drafts and the evidence page; without homework or self-play paths they wait for labels before any student.
lessons: Before recording a step's columns, check what names the log uses against the profile the state is read from.
Anything a decision produced is its outcome, never its evidence: keep the state to what was known before.
risks: data.cleaning_keep holds one answer until a person can revert a step or homework marks one wrong.
